content_of_post_to_comment:
I feel like my phone has completely taken over my life.
After work or even during any downtime on the weekends, all I want to do is scroll Reddit, YouTube, Instagram, or research random things online. My screen time averages around 9 hours a day and I can tell my attention span has gotten terrible. I can’t even enjoy watching TV anymore because I’d rather be on my phone. Even spending quality time with my partner is hard because I constantly have the urge to pick my phone up and start scrolling. I want to quit or at least cut back, but I’m honestly afraid I’ll just be painfully bored. It almost feels like I’d have to pretend to enjoy other activities at first, like forcing myself to watch a movie, read, or do something without reaching for my phone every few minutes. Has anyone else gone through this? Did the constant boredom eventually go away? How long did it take before things started feeling enjoyable again without needing your phone all the time?
